scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a VA home purchase loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved or denied?
dialogue.agent: Your VA home purchase loan application has been approved. The loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. Can you also share the interest rate and the total costs associated with this loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 6.75%. The total costs associated with the loan are $3,164.50.

dialogue.user: I see. Are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: No, your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for that information. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Yes, your loan has been purchased by Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user: I see. What is my debt-to-income ratio and what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: The record does not include a debt-to-income ratio for your loan. You were approved for a VA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Understood. Thank you for the information. <Satisfied> The agent was clear and provided all the information I needed to know about my loan status and details.
